scientific_integrity: All combinatorial ranks are computed exactly over F2 from complete quotient flag orbits, independently of the published connectivity and orbit-space fundamental-group theorems. Mathematical review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-local homotopy type is determined. Possible odd-primary integral torsion and full integral homotopy type are not claimed. The finite orbit-chain calculation is exhaustive at three stabilized widths; its extension uses a proven six-column bound.
title: A two-local sphere theorem for full column-symmetry quotients of three-row two-matching complexes
